description: This Kotlin source file defines the core AuthManager class responsible for managing authentication states, token storage, login, logout, lock/unlock operations, and token refresh logic in an Android application. It provides an API for UI components to interact with the authentication system, abstracting network operations and token handling.

classes.name: AuthManager
classes.description: A singleton class managing authentication state, token persistence, login/logout processes, session locking/unlocking, and token refresh in an Android context. Provides an API for app components to handle user authentication workflows.

methods.name: authStateFlow
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits authentication state changes.

methods.name: currentState
methods.description: Retrieves the current authentication state snapshot.

methods.name: initializeFromStorage
methods.description: Loads persisted session tokens from storage during app startup, setting the initial auth state accordingly.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login by exchanging credentials for tokens, then persisting tokens and updating auth state.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the current session, keeping tokens persisted but setting the app into a locked state.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the session after biometric or device credential verification, updating the auth state.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears stored tokens and sets the auth state to logged out.

methods.name: getAccessTokenIfUnlocked
methods.description: Returns the current access token if the session is unlocked; otherwise, fails.

methods.name: ensureFreshAccessToken
methods.description: Checks if the current access token is valid; if expired, performs refresh operation, updates storage, and state.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate AuthManager with default dependencies.

methods.name: createForTesting
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate AuthManager with injected dependencies for testing.
